title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 17.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability was found and remediated in GitLab CE/EE versions from 17.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6. This flaw allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browsers of users viewing a wiki page due to improper sanitization of user input. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.7.
